method: Node zlib.gzipSync level 9 (owner decision 2026-09-20, amends decision 10's 'gzip -9' by pinning the implementation, not the level or format). Budgets are per-manifest-chunk gzip bytes.

startup.note: Entry's static closure: the index.html entry file, its static imports, and their linked CSS. Not a fixed file list — a new eagerly-imported chunk joins the closure automatically. Measured 87,982 B at dev 4c45d26a (B7-7); headroom ~2 kB. Raised 90,000 -> 91,000 B by owner decision (B7-10a): the dispatcher handler split into src/features/*/wsHandlers.ts costs +435 B (89,993 B at dev c18cf5a8 -> 90,428 B; +456 B at be7a0594), all module wrappers and unminifiable clock field names, not new code.

MainPage.note: Measured 56,855 B at dev 4c45d26a (B7-7). Raised 60,000 -> 61,000 B for B9-7: dev 5682b410 measured 59,944 B (56 B headroom) and the NSFW consent gate (pre-load gate, withdraw bar, consent copy catalog) brings it to 60,794 B.

livekitSession.note: Measured 21,652 B after the B7-9 split (livekitSession and livekitE2EE facades plus src/features/voice/). Ratchet rule (B7-9): measured + 10 %, rounded up to the next 1,000 B — 21,652 x 1.10 = 23,817 -> 24,000. Replaces decision 10's 800,000 B post-decomposition placeholder.

forbidEmbeddedWasm.note: No emitted JS chunk may contain the base64 WASM magic. Generalises decision 10's forbidWasmInStartup: the RNNoise barrel regression (C-07) embeds 1.9 MB of sync WASM in whatever chunk pulls it, which is exactly this marker.
